title: AIR PACK 1 FAULT

actions.discrepancy: The pack 1 flow control valve still shows open.

actions.say: If the fault was an overheat, wait for it to cool before any reset attempt.

status: Status. Pack 1 off; pack 2 is supplying conditioned air.
Expect a reduced total air flow and a slower cabin temperature response.
If both packs are lost, a maximum flight level limitation applies; refer to the Q.R.H.
